Code execution.Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD: Code execution is billed at the standard token rates for the selected model. Costs are determined solely by the tool's usage, no charges are accrued for the session runtime. The generated code and execution results are billed as Output tokens when created, and as Input tokens when the model uses them as part of its iterative reasoning process.

URL context.Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD: Charged as input tokens per model pricing.

Computer use.Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD: Charged as regular tokens per model pricing (e.g., standard Gemini 3.5 Flash pricing). See the Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Preview pricing table for legacy model rates.

File search.Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD: Charged for embeddings at $0.15 / 1M tokens.Retrieved document tokens charged as regular tokens per model pricing.

Custom Tools endpoint (Gemini 3.1 Pro Pr.Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD: Same as Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview pricing

Gemini Deep Research agent.Model: All model inference is charged at standard Gemini list rates, including input, output, and intermediate input / reasoning tokens generated during agentic loops.
Gemini Deep Research agent.Tools: Tool usage fees apply per existing pricing structure, maintaining standard distinctions for Search Grounding (retrieved tokens excluded) versus Url_context / File Search (retrieved tokens included in all other tools).

Managed agents in Gemini API.Model: All model inference is charged at standard Gemini list rates, including input, output, and intermediate input / reasoning tokens generated during agentic loops. (See pricing details).
Managed agents in Gemini API.Tools: Environment compute (CPU, memory, sandbox execution) is not billed during the preview period.

Antigravity Agent.Model: All model inference is charged at standard Gemini list rates, including input, output, and intermediate input / reasoning tokens generated during agentic loops. (See pricing details).
Antigravity Agent.Tools: Environment compute (CPU, memory, sandbox execution) is not billed during the preview period.
